title: Cirrus Immersive Visor Pro 5
description: The Cirrus Immersive Visor Pro 5 is a Signature-original immersive visor in the vr headsets family. It tracks the working profile of Meta Quest 3 — mixed-reality headset: Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2 with 8 GB of RAM, starting at $499. Introduced in 2023, it serves mainstream VR users.
